output_units.mu_hat_horizon: expected return over horizon (daily_log_return scale summed)
output_units.mu_raw_score: raw CNN output prior to calibration (unitless score)

selection_rationale: Phase-4 winner from ensemble_search.csv (rank corr sort, k=4): logistic_image_scale + cnn_1d_cumulative_scale + cnn_2d_residual_small + cnnlstm_image_scale (teammate's improved CNN+LSTM hybrid). OOS rank corr 0.0671 (#1), top-k Sharpe 0.541. Both metrics improved vs the previous lstm_image_scale variant (0.0653 / 0.452). Note that ensemble_best (3-member, no LSTM) still has the highest Sharpe (0.630). Use ensemble_4family when point-prediction quality matters more; ensemble_best for portfolio Sharpe priority.
